source.selection_rule: Select the next non-placeholder experiment workbook after Experiment 15 without opening workbook rows

included: laboratory two-stage metal-hydride compressor component plausibility
time-series pressure, temperature and hydrogen-flow channel consistency
excluded: ESD, leak, fire or consequence-distance validation

protocol.calibration: No coefficient fitting, parameter tuning, or runtime update from this holdout
required_checks: workbook opens and contains a declared time-series sheet
elapsed-time column is monotonic or its violations are reported
pressure, temperature and flow families are identified with source units
non-finite values, duplicate timestamps and gaps are reported
summary statistics and physical sign/range checks are reported without censoring failures
numerical_metrics: only if a separately attested metal-hydride component model and unit conversion are available
protocol.acceptance: diagnostic only; no readiness gate promotion

claim_boundary: This preregistered holdout can provide independent component schema/compatibility evidence only. It cannot validate the HRS full loop, station-to-vehicle synchronization, safety response, HyRAM consequence distance, or LLM effectiveness.
